edges.reason: Constructor assigns msg.sender to owner, establishing the privileged role.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against owner to gate privileged functions.
msg.sender determines the caller's entry accounting inside enterDraw.
msg.sender is the from-address of the Oil.burn external call in enterDraw.
block.timestamp feeds the randomness computation in getRandom (timestamp dependency).
block.timestamp is the entropy source of the weak randomness unsafe operation.
pickWinner consumes getRandom's timestamp-derived output as the draw base.
getRandom return value is stored in pickWinner.rand.
_numOfTickets drives the ticket-cost multiplication and the loop bound.
_numOfTickets is multiplied by ticketPrice to form totalTicketCost.
ticketPrice is multiplied by _numOfTickets to compute totalTicketCost.
totalTicketCost is the amount argument of the Oil.burn external call.
enterDraw executes the Oil.burn call after validations but before state updates.
The external burn call into an arbitrary token contract can re-enter enterDraw before userEntries/players are updated.
enterDraw performs the Oil.balanceOf external call inside its validation phase.
The Oil interface state variable is the callee of the balanceOf operation.
enterDraw runs the player ticket purchasing loop.
The loop pushes msg.sender into the players array.
The loop increments userEntries[msg.sender] for every ticket.
userEntries[msg.sender] is read into ownerTicketsPurchased for the cap check.
ownerTicketsPurchased participates in the require limiting entries to maxTicketsPerTx.
enterDraw both reads and writes userEntries to track per-user tickets.
drawLive is required to be true for entries to be accepted.
maxTicketsPerTx bounds _numOfTickets in enterDraw.
Loop counter i bounds the entry loop.
Loop counter drives the players.push iterations.
pickWinner writes winner addresses into pastDraw.
drawId is incremented for every winner stored in pickWinner.
players is indexed by the computed winner indices in pickWinner.
_firstSalt offsets the first winner index.
Owner-supplied salt controls the winner selection outcome.
rand is the base of the first winner index computation.
_ninethSalt produces the final winner index of the salt chain.
pickWinner performs the salt-based winner selection operation.
setOil uses the supplied address as the configured token.
setOil writes oilAddress.
setOil casts the supplied address into the Oil interface.
setOil lets the owner repoint the external token contract arbitrarily.
onlyOwner guards setOil.
onlyOwner guards pickWinner.
onlyOwner guards setTicketPrice.
onlyOwner guards setMaxTicket.
onlyOwner guards startEntries.
onlyOwner guards stopEntries.
onlyOwner guards transferOwnership.
_newTicketPrice is written into ticketPrice.
setTicketPrice mutates the ticketPrice state variable.
_maxTickets is written into maxTicketsPerTx.
setMaxTicket mutates the maxTicketsPerTx state variable.
startEntries flips drawLive to true.
stopEntries flips drawLive to false.
_address becomes the new owner without zero-address validation.
transferOwnership reassigns the owner state variable.
_drawId is the lookup key into pastDraw.
getWinnerByDraw reads pastDraw[_drawId].
_player is the address being counted.
_player is copied into addressOfPlayer.
addressOfPlayer is compared against players[i] in the counting loop.
playerEntries iterates the players array.
arrayLength caches players.length as the loop bound.
totalEntries is the returned count of matching entries.
Loop counter i drives the players scan.
getPlayers returns the players array.
drawEntrys returns players.length.
getRandom reduces by players.length to index the array.
rand is reduced modulo players.length to produce index.
index is the return value of getRandom.
